description: Cross exchange rate between two SEK currency-fixing series over a date range. series1 is the base, series2 the quote; the result is series1/series2 per day. Example: series1 "SEKEURPMI", series2 "SEKUSDPMI" gives EUR/USD derived from the SEK fixings. Provide from (required) and optionally to (both YYYY-MM-DD); omit to to run through the latest date. Use SEK currency series IDs ending in "PMI" (see list_series).

to.description: Range end, YYYY-MM-DD (optional; defaults to latest).

name: cross_rates
title: Cross Rates
